scientific_scope: case-paired outcome of frozen models; not training-seed inference

descriptive_motion_definitions.progress_efficiency: net goal-distance reduction / executed path length
descriptive_motion_definitions.backtracking_ratio: fraction of steps increasing goal distance by more than 1mm
descriptive_motion_definitions.low_progress_windows: fraction of complete 8-step (2s) windows with <20cm net goal progress; descriptive, not a pathology label or acceptance criterion
descriptive_motion_definitions.stall_fraction: fraction of executed steps with speed <0.1m/s

training_root_counterfactuals.interpretation: Descriptive catalog headroom on training roots, not deployed method improvement or independent episodes.
